hero.title: Real health coverage when ACA isn't an option
hero.subtitle: No immigration status required and no open enrollment window to wait for. Start your secure application online — it only takes a few minutes.

benefits.title: No immigration status required
benefits.desc: These plans are available regardless of immigration status — no Social Security number requirement to get covered.

benefits.title: Enroll any time of year
benefits.desc: There's no open enrollment period and no qualifying life event needed. Apply the day you need coverage.

benefits.title: Built for the self-employed
benefits.desc: A practical fit for freelancers, contractors, business owners and students who don't get a subsidy or an employer plan.

benefits.title: Bilingual, licensed support
benefits.desc: Get help in English or Spanish from a licensed advisor at every step.

steps.title: Open your secure application
steps.desc: Tap Apply now and your private application opens immediately — no account, no password. Come back on this device anytime to pick up where you left off.

steps.title: Fill out the secure form
steps.desc: Answer a few guided questions about you and anyone else you want covered. Everything is encrypted and saves automatically as you go.

steps.title: We review and reach out
steps.desc: Once you submit, we review your application and contact you to confirm your plan and start date.

healthAlternativeApply.secureNote: Your information is encrypted and never shared. This process is 100% secure.
healthAlternativeApply.ctaNote: No account or password needed — your progress saves automatically as you go.
